description: This file defines a custom 'link' mark for a rich text editor, including its configuration, parsing, rendering, commands, input and paste rules, and ProseMirror plugins. It manages link creation, toggling, and removal, and integrates linkifyjs for URL detection and protocol registration.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: A custom Mark extension for handling links in the editor, including options for autolinking, protocols, click behavior, and paste handling.

methods.name: insertLink
methods.description: Function to insert or toggle a link mark with specified attributes, handling selection and existing marks.
